prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: fresco. Texture family: weathered porous limestone and dry sandstone with raw mineral wash grain. Palette: parchment and bone-white ground, warm raw ochre, burnt umber silhouettes, muted terracotta, and soft charcoal-black accents. Line treatment: primitive gestural strokes and flat graphic silhouettes with tapered, hand-painted contour edges. Lighting: flat natural ambient daylight with diffuse cave-mouth warmth and minimal cast shadows. Avoid: no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no glossy digital gradients, no vector crispness, no modern manufactured clothing or tools, no text or UI elements. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
